published.source: Client 70425 racials and the raid damage hits, re-measured on master 4f5c608, 2026-10-16

verify.note: same sim as the published number

summary: Arms with Spearing Strike and Improved Bloodrage, for a Giant or Dragonkin boss such as Onyxia. 4.0% ahead of normal Arms on that boss at 180 s.
advantage: Spearing Strike does 80% more damage to Giants and Dragonkin. That makes it worth a place in the rotation. Normal Arms spends those points elsewhere.
advantageShort: Spearing Strike does 80% more damage to Giants and Dragonkin, so it joins the rotation.
rotation: Sunder Armor as the first GCD after the pull (every warrior; the tanks keep it up after)
With 25 sec left, Recklessness ready and under 25 Rage: swap to Berserker Stance, and back to Battle Stance once Recklessness is out
Death Wish held for the last 36 sec, Recklessness in the last 25 sec; racials with Death Wish (Blood Fury and Berserking also at the end of the fight)
Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 20 sec; Bloodrage under 10 Rage
Slam from 20 Rage (15 sec cooldown with Improved Slam), outside execute
Rend kept up outside execute; then Execute
Heroic Strike from 70 Rage, Hamstring filler from 20 Rage (outside execute)
caveats: Spearing Strike only works against Giants and Dragonkin

White hit Rage is normalized to the weapon: k × swing speed (k is 3.46 one-hand and 4.5 two-hand, measured at level 30). It grows with level to ×1.5 at 60, the same for the off hand. Not yet measured at 60.
No Fury Dragonkin build: stance dancing for Spearing Strike adds only 0.4% (dual wield) and 0.8% (two-hand).
Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 30 Strength and 16 crit rating, and an on-use 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
Synthetic Phase 1 gear on Forever's physical budget (ids 991001-991018)
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Deep Wounds ticks can't crit (client data). Each crit restarting the Deep Wounds tick timer is our modeling choice.
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is white hits only, and Heroic Strike swings count for Unbridled Wrath.
One +2% crit elixir per character, since it's unknown if Ferocity stacks with Mongoose. A second one (Grizzly) would add 10.9.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece (+36 AP vs Humanoids) not counted. It would add 8.4 (Undead, 180 s).
Booming Voice (5/5) does nothing because the raid has Battle Shout
Raid damage hits on the warrior (2 a minute at 1500 damage, about 15 Rage each) are estimated from boss timers. The assumptions panel also runs 0 and 10 a minute.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as warrior__arms except talents and APL, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeDragonkin, as the class preset's encounter does.
